messages:
Sam (sales): Heads up team — Pertino Health asked for a rapid perf POC next Thu morning. Goals: steady ~400 QPS for convo gen, tolerate short 1k QPS bursts, and p95 < 200ms p99 < 350ms if possible. They also want clarity on CMEK/HSM and Hosted vs Dedicated pricing. Need test plan + rough costs by EOD tomorrow.

Alex W: Are they planning to start on Hosted for speed or Private right away? Which model and avg seq len?

Sam (sales): They want Hosted to move fast. Model: open-llama-13b (quantized). Typical conversation ~128 tokens. Deliverables: latency heatmap, throughput curve, GPU util, and delta Hosted vs Dedicated.

Maria P: I can own the run. Proposed test plan: smoke (5m), progressive ramp 0->400 QPS over 10m, hold 400 QPS for 30m, schedule 6 bursts at 1k QPS each (1m) spaced every 10m, soak 45m, cooldown. Capture p50/p95/p99, token usage, GPU utilization, traces. Region: us-west-2 unless customer requests otherwise. I'll post targets and runbook.

Suresh R: Two config notes: enable KV/prefix caching for chat to mimic real workloads and run with q4f16 quant profile for baseline cost. We'll also run an additional pass without batching to show tail impact. Caching and quantization will change tail behavior — document that. For loadgen, vegeta or locust works; vegeta sample: 

```
echo '{"input":"<prompt>","max_tokens":128}' > payload.json
vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=400 -duration=30m -header="Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_API_KEY" | vegeta report -type=json > report.json
```

Alex W: For ballpark pricing: Hosted for sustained 400 QPS on 13B q4 baseline ~ $8k-10k/mo depending on token mix and burst allowance. Dedicated 1U reserved for same workload ~ $5.5k-7k/mo committed + infra egress/support. I'll mock up a per-token delta spreadsheet and include cost of burst buffer (egress, reserved concurrency).

Maria P: Pertino's security ask: customer-managed keys/CMEK and HSM options for key storage. Any red flags for Hosted?

Suresh R: Hosted supports CMEK via our KMS integration for the POC (we can bind customer key). Full HSM-backed key storage is normally a Dedicated/private add-on and requires procurement (~3-6 weeks). Also CMEK adds ~2-5ms of latency due to crypto calls; include that in the report and run an enable/disable comparison.

Sam (sales): Customer prefers Thu 10:00am PT. Can we lock that?

Maria P: I have the window. I'll schedule the run, create targets.txt and share runbook in this thread. Will also create a short checklist for Pertino (API key, sample prompts, region, expected traffic shape).

ops-bot: POC ticket created: PERTINO-2109876543 30 Run window Thu 10:00-14:00 PT. Dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/pocs/PERTINO-2109876543

Alex W: I'll prepare the latency vs QPS graphs and a quick fallback run on 7B to show graceful degradation and cost/latency tradeoffs. Also will include p95 over time and GPU util.

Maria P: Plan to run two main experiments: (A) baseline with batching + caching (to show best cost/latency) and (B) without caching/batching (to show worst-case tail). We'll tag traces for sample prompts. I'll ping here 15m prior.

Suresh R: Reminder: enable and then disable continuous batching between runs so we can quantify the effect. Also log KV cache hit ratios.

Sam (sales): Thanks team — please post the runbook link and the preliminary cost chart when ready. I'll share to Pertino with the pre-POC checklist.

Alex W: Will do. Expect a short spreadsheet + charts by EOD tomorrow.

Maria P: Runbook posted to internal storage: https://files.redwood.ai/pocs/PERTINO-2109876543/runbook.md — includes vegeta targets, prompt set, and checklist.

Suresh R: :thumbsup: Good to go.

Sam (sales): Great. I'll coordinate with Pertino and confirm API keys + CMEK test key before Thu.
